# Task: Add README Badges

## Objective

Add the following badges to the README.md file:

- License MIT badge
- GitHub Actions CI status badge
- Node.js version badge
- TypeScript badge

## Requirements

- Add badges at the top of the README.md file
- Use standard GitHub badge format from shields.io
- Keep existing content intact
- Use proper markdown syntax

## Expected Badges

```markdown
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![CI](https://github.com/USERNAME/REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/USERNAME/REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-20-green.svg)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.8-blue.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Badges are displayed at the top of README.md
- [ ] All badges are properly formatted
- [ ] Existing content remains unchanged
- [ ] Badges are clickable and link to appropriate resources
